== stop (complete gate) ==
DRY [gradle:verify] (): <ROOT>/gradlew -q --console=plain verify
DRY [web:lint] (/frontend/web): npm run -s lint
DRY [web:test] (/frontend/web): npm run -s test
DRY [web:stryker] (/frontend/web): npx --no-install stryker run --incremental
